![](thumbnail.png)

## Overview

This figure asks whether the same nominal tuition bill became easier or harder to afford for households at different points in the income distribution. It combines the higher-education tuition price series with household income by decile, tracking how the ratio between the two moved for the poorest and richest deciles since 2002.

## Methodology

The tuition-burden index divides the same real tuition-readjustment series used in the IPCA tuition figure by the weighted mean real per-capita household income of each decile, both expressed as 2002 = 100 and both deflated by the same IPCA base. Deciles are computed within each survey year and source; the harmonized series uses PNAD Anual through 2015 and PNAD Contínua from 2016 onward, with 2012–2015 restricted to PNAD Anual observations. Because the burden is a ratio of two indices anchored at the same base year, it says nothing about the absolute affordability of tuition in any single year — only about how a fixed nominal bill moved relative to each decile's own income trajectory since 2002. The underlying tuition series is a fixed-panel readjustment index and does not register the additional compositional cheapening from the post-2015 migration toward distance learning, so the burden shown is, if anything, an upper bound on how much lighter the bill became for lower deciles.

## Pipeline

This figure draws on the [PNAD / PNAD Contínua Harmonization, 1992–2025](../harmonizacao-pnad-pnadc/) panel.

Run these scripts in this order, from the project root (each one writes to `data-raw/`, which the next one reads):

1. [`shared-pipeline/pnadc/000_PNADC_Download_Consolidate.R`](../../shared-pipeline/pnadc/000_PNADC_Download_Consolidate.R) — downloads PNAD Contínua 2012–2025 (1st interview) with `PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc()` into `data-raw/pnadc_raw/` and consolidates it into `data-raw/pnadc_consolidado_2012_2025_interview1.rds`
2. [`shared-pipeline/pnadc/020_PNAD_Anual_Manual_Import_2001_2015.R`](../../shared-pipeline/pnadc/020_PNAD_Anual_Manual_Import_2001_2015.R) — downloads the PNAD Anual 2001–2015 microdata from the IBGE FTP into `data-raw/pnad_anual_raw/` and imports them into `data-raw/harmonizing-br-data/output/PNAD_Anual_2001_2015.parquet`
3. [`shared-pipeline/pnadc/050_PNAD_Historica_Manual_Import_1992_1999.R`](../../shared-pipeline/pnadc/050_PNAD_Historica_Manual_Import_1992_1999.R) — same for PNAD Anual 1992–1999 (`PNAD_Anual_1992_1999.parquet`)
4. [`shared-pipeline/pnadc/035_Splice_Microdados.R`](../../shared-pipeline/pnadc/035_Splice_Microdados.R) — splices PNAD Anual and PNAD Contínua into the harmonized panel — `Microdados_Todas_Idades_1992_2025.parquet` and `Microdados_Jovens_18_24_1992_2025.parquet` in `data-raw/harmonizing-br-data/output/` (sources `shared-pipeline/utils/codigos_curso_pnad.R`)
5. [`shared-pipeline/ipca/010_IPCA_Curso_Superior_Series.R`](../../shared-pipeline/ipca/010_IPCA_Curso_Superior_Series.R) — downloads the IPCA tuition sub-item and minimum-wage series (SIDRA / IPEADATA) and writes `data-raw/ipca-mensalidades/output/serie_mensalidade_mensal.rds`
6. [`plot.R`](plot.R) — reads `Microdados_Todas_Idades_1992_2025.parquet` and `serie_mensalidade_mensal.rds`; writes the figure to `output/figures/fardo-mensalidade-decil/` — compare it with this post's `thumbnail.png`

All of the upstream steps above are Tier A and are also run, in this same order, by [`shared-pipeline/build_public_data.R`](../../shared-pipeline/build_public_data.R).

## Reproducibility

**Tier: A**

This pipeline uses only public data, accessible via package/API without any credential (PNADcIBGE, censobr, sidrar, ipeadatar). Run the scripts in `shared-pipeline/` in numeric order to reconstruct the intermediate data.
